# Qwen Code 0.24.2 identity fixture

This fixture freezes the official `@qwen-code/qwen-code` npm package and
matching QwenLM/qwen-code `v0.23.4` through `v0.24.2` release/tag evidence
used by Research 334. The package contents were extracted for hashing only;
no downloaded artifact was executed and no provider request was made.

`identity.json` records the official channel metadata, missing-host
observation, and the compatible-extension decision. `protocol.json` records
the selected headless surface and the bounded classification of changed
upstream files. `dist-inventory.json` is the complete extracted package
path/hash inventory for every published stable hop after the previous
`0.23.3` ceiling.
